notes.title: IMPORTANT UPDATE ON ROGUE SAMURAI – THANK YOU FOR THE JOURNEY!
notes.notes:
Hey Samurai,

I grew up in a small village, and my favorite memories from childhood involve the breeze gently sweeping through lush green fields, making everything look like a painting. Years later, while reading Musashi’s story in Vagabond, I saw a scene that took me right back to those days, sparking the idea behind Rogue Samurai. Because of this personal connection, I put my heart into making the game, but as a first-time developer, I couldn’t fully translate this vision into reality. For this, I truly apologize.

We've had an amazing journey together since the launch of Rogue Samurai. Your enthusiasm, feedback, and support have meant everything to our little team.

Today, we want to be completely open with you about the game's future. After a lot of thought, we've decided not to continue updating Rogue Samurai. It was a tough choice, but we believe it's important to be honest with the wonderful community that’s been with us since the beginning.

Rogue Samurai was our very first game, and honestly, we learned a ton. Unfortunately, many of you felt the rough edges and our early mistakes—we simply couldn’t make the game everything we originally dreamed of. Still, seeing players from all around the world enjoying it and sharing feedback was incredibly rewarding for us. Due to tough economic conditions facing our studio, we’ve had to shift our focus to new projects.

Despite this, we deeply appreciate every single one of you who supported Rogue Samurai, helped us grow, and stuck with us on this adventure. We’re currently working on some exciting new projects, and we can’t wait to show you what's next. If you have any memories, screenshots, or stories from your time playing Rogue Samurai, please share them—we'd love to see them!

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Your samurai spirit made this experience unforgettable.

Warmest wishes,
CO's Entertainment Team

notes.title: Rogue Samurai 1.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Finally, we're moving our game into full release! We extend infinite thanks to all our followers who accompanied us on this adventure during the Early Access period. The awaited moment has arrived; here are the patch notes!

[b]Major Updates:[/b]

[b]New Weapons: Hand of God and Yumi![/b]
Previously, Buddha would help you from above; now you can feel his power directly in your hands! Get ready to give your enemies a divine touch with the Hand of God. Yumi was designed for those tired of ordinary bows; now you can shoot more powerful arrows. Don't forget to try it, but be careful—your arrows might pierce through targets!

[b]Menus Overhauled![/b]
We had revamped the in-game interfaces, and now we've completely overhauled the menu interfaces from top to bottom! We've eliminated the issues that occurred when switching between gamepad and keyboard. Moreover, the interfaces are now more in tune with the game's theme. Get ready to feast your eyes!

[b]Brand New Bosses and Events![/b]
Bosses have been completely renewed, and 2 new bosses have been added to the game! There are also new events for previously existing bosses. Battles will now be even more challenging. The Bamboo Forest and our new map, Mount Fuji, have their own unique bosses. Be careful on our final map, Fuji; reaching the summit is never easy!

[b]New Map: Mount Fuji![/b]
You've finally reached the summit! Our game's final map, Mount Fuji, has been added to the game. But remember, it's very cold here; don't forget to dress warmly, or your samurai might freeze!

[b]Minor Quality Updates:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented the necessary health upgrade from increasing with "Basic Instinct."
[*] Gems now move faster. You won't have to chase after them!
[*] The sound that plays when collecting gems has been fixed. Now your ears will rejoice!
[*] The Dojo stage has been made easier. It will now cause less sweat for beginners.
[*] You can navigate between upgrade interfaces with keyboard and gamepad. No need to rely on the mouse!
[*] The magnet upgrade has been added to the game. Gems will fly towards you, so you can sit back and relax.
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented the game from launching on the first start. No need for magic words to start the game now!
[*] Gamepad vibration issue fixed. Your hands will be free from unwanted tremors.
[*] The issue of being able to use "Kami Speed" and "Explosion" without acquiring any skills has been resolved. No more cheating!
[*] The problem where new skills wouldn't appear even after acquiring them has been fixed. Now you'll gain the powers you deserve.
[*] New visual effects have been added for time slowing and "Twin Samurai." You'll look even cooler!
[*] Animations have been updated. A brand new animation system has been implemented. Your movements will be smoother.
[*] Resolution can be adjusted when launching on Steam Deck. Don't strain your eyes!
[*] Enemy AIs have been revamped. Your enemies are now smarter... or so they think.
[*] Optimizations have been made. Our game now runs more smoothly.
[*] Bosses were not noticeable. Now it's impossible to miss them!
[*] Miyamato Village has been removed from the game. This has improved both optimization and fluidity. Say goodbye to the village.
[*] The displayed names of the maps you've entered on Discord have been corrected. Now your friends will know where you are.
[*] Cooldown reduction levels have been decreased. Previously, it reduced by 60% at "Legendary" level; now it reduces by 30%. Be patient!
[*] Customized sounds have been added for weapons. Each weapon has its own tone."
[*] New events have been added. Get ready for surprises!
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Samurai New Content Update!
notes.notes:
We've been working on a new content update for you with our team for a while now. We're thrilled to finally share it with you. Here are the patch notes:

[b]Major Updates:[/b]
Meet the Bosses of Zen Garden and Oda Castle!
Miss sweating it out in battles? Here’s your chance! Now, Zen Garden and Oda Castle have their own special bosses. Each one is full of surprises just for you (spoiler: get ready to lose a lot). Can you figure out their combat patterns and conquer them? We’ll see!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/e2ee94d31d0f707adae46204018ef0441292bde9.gif[/img]

[b]Brand New Map: Bamboo Forest![/b]
Your journey toward Fuji just got even scarier! In this eerie bamboo forest, enemies are lurking, waiting for you. Who knows, you might just find yourself lost among the bamboos. Be careful, this place is definitely not for beginners!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/cecfa794d5a0bb3151dd5f792c0e14671bccdc16.gif[/img]

[b]Meet Our New Dragon![/b]
Our dear old dragon has retired and is now living a peaceful life in the wild. But don’t worry, we’ve caught a new dragon! After a long hunt, we’ve finally tamed this massive beauty. It will now accompany you in battle. Just be careful not to step on its tail!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/6a6aa4a0eb0a956030f498b5e59e22aa41ca0244.gif[/img]

[b]New Weapon: Kanabo![/b]
If you love spinning and smashing, this weapon is just for you! With the new Kanabo, you can attack your enemies like a whirlwind. But fair warning, you might need to save up some more money to unlock it. Power doesn’t come cheap!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/b7352a0b8ac64994f0dd3bdc610b5a1f4e9ac434.gif[/img]

[b]Completely Revamped UI![/b]
We’ve said goodbye to our old UI and now present you with a brand-new, super stylish user interface. You no longer need a magnifying glass to see rank differences; with the effects we’ve added, everything is crystal clear!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/f71157663cfc4be088b77c65a067e079c5411081.gif[/img]

[b]New Music![/b]
Want to get pumped up during battles? Then make sure to listen to the new music tracks we’ve added. You’ll feel like a rock star while taking down your enemies to the beat!

[b]Minor Quality Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies in the Dojo scene have been weakened.
[*] Weapon upgrades now properly apply in-game.
[*] Sound and translation issues have been fixed.
[*] Dragon breath no longer obscures the screen.
[*] Sumo-related bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Samurai Big Update!
notes.notes:
[b]v0.1.3 Patch Notes


New Languages[/b]

11 new languages added: Turkish, Spanish, Italian, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, French, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Russian.


[b]New Features and Changes[/b]

Auto Aim: Your character will now automatically aim at the nearest enemy. This feature can be adjusted from the pause menu.

Blood Settings: Since blood effects impact game performance, blood-related settings can now be adjusted from the pause menu.

Damage Texts: Damage texts will now also appear for passive abilities.

Boss AI: Boss AI has been changed.

Dash: You can now upgrade Dash speed and cooldown. However, to balance this, you will now take damage while dashing.

Passive Skills: Passive skill values now appear below the skills.

Damage Passive Skill: The damage passive skill now increases all damage dealt. Previously, it only increased basic attack damage.

New Upgrade System: Skills no longer have rarity indicators; instead, skill values increase as a rarity indicator. For example, Flaming Rage Attack Speed +10% Rare.

Passive Abilities: New passive abilities will now appear at the bottom when acquired.

Level Up: The game now pauses when you level up to show the upgrade screen.

Enemy Scaling: Enemies will get stronger as time progresses. Regardless of your level, enemies will continue to develop.

Cooldown Passive Skill: Added.


[b]Optimizations[/b]

General Optimization: Various optimizations have been made to improve game performance.

Ragdoll Optimization: To address the slowdown when many enemies are killed simultaneously, ragdolls can be disabled from the settings menu.

Shock Zone: Removed due to the significant optimization issues it caused.

Health Bars: Removed punchscale from enemy health bars as it was deemed unnecessary.

Enemies Disappear Faster: Enemies now disappear more quickly after being killed.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Dojo Scene: Fixed the issue causing FPS drops when moving to the corners of the map.

Geishas: Adjusted their appearance.

XP Bar: Fixed the issue causing the XP bar to remain full even after leveling up.


Sharpen your blades, embrace the challenge, and keep the feedback coming, Samurai! We're always listening and eager to improve based on your input.

Join us on our social channels and share your thoughts. Thanks for being part of our journey, and stay sharp!

notes.title: Rogue Samurai Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Samurai!

We’ve been hard at work in the dojo, and we’ve got some incredible new features and improvements for Rogue Samurai that we can’t wait for you to try!

Here’s what’s new:

[b]Sharpen Those Arrows![/b]
[list]
[*] Maximum arrow count has been upped to 4. That's right, four times the chaos!
[*] We’ve added arrow penetration. Watch your arrows slice through multiple enemies like a hot katana through butter.
[/list]

[b]Weapon Upgrades Galore![/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed that pesky bug in the weapon upgrade system.
[*] Base damage for all weapons has been increased. Feel the power coursing through your blade!
[*] Arrows are now a bit slower, giving you a chance to marvel at their flight.
[*] Arrows now deactivate faster when they miss their target, preventing those sneaky long-range hits.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Tweaks & Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the spawn system to keep the action flowing.
[*] You can no longer attack while dashing. Timing is everything!
[*] Removed the flashing explosion effect when dealing damage. Your eyes will thank us!
[*] Increased the XP gain. Leveling up has never been more satisfying!
[*] Improved arrow targeting to better align with your mouse aim. Hit your mark every time!
[*] Added immersive sounds for drawing and shooting arrows. Feel the tension and release!
[/list]

[b]Level Up in Style:[/b]
[list]
[*] When you level up, a cool particle effect now appears above your character. Show off your progress!
[*] We’ve also balanced the in-game difficulty and economy, ensuring a more polished and challenging experience.
[/list]

Stay sharp and keep those feedbacks coming, Samurai! Your journey is our journey, and we’re dedicated to making Rogue Samurai the best it can be.

Thanks for your support, and keep your blades ready!

notes.title: Rogue Samurai Content Update
notes.notes:
Hey Samurai!

We've been hard at work behind the scenes, forging new features and enhancements for Rogue Samurai, and we can't wait to show you what's new!

First up, let's talk weapons! We've added two brand new weapons for you to master. Whether you prefer the swift precision of a bow or the brute force of a naginata, we've got you covered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/042bcc0d14eaefa9fd761479250ed55a30224e17.gif[/img]

And guess what? Now, you can upgrade your weapons at the blacksmith! Bring your favorite tools of destruction to new heights and dominate the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/4441fa1c640e43f5e1b301033658e395aae906b2.gif[/img]

We've also waved goodbye to the damage rune. It had a good run, but it's time for something fresh.

Say hello to the new faces in Miyamoto Village! We've added a blacksmith and Musashi models to give the village more life and character.

Watch out for the new enemy types and behaviors! Now you’ll face kamikaze monks diving at you and sumo wrestlers leaping like hulks. They’re here to keep you on your toes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/e03bb17dd3e48495e3592ea3a36191da8a926fc3.gif[/img]

Are you ready for our new event? Step into the Cage, where you must survive for 30 seconds. If you succeed, Dana White might just want to sign you! But beware, life is full of surprises—sumos and kamikazes will be charging at you in the cage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/38fa415857c41b60ce1ebdf4b13716f640916461.gif[/img]

We've added 13 new passive skills. We know 13 is an unlucky number, but we hope it brings you good fortune!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/34f4572027a9535fbb9ab677b440dc87c72166b4.gif[/img]

In terms of balance, we've adjusted the in-game economy. Now, you might feel a bit more... financially challenged in the game. 💸

New to the game? No worries! We’ve added a tutorial for rookies to get you started on your journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/8edd2d092634fd9991f828627e06848071e46079.gif[/img]

Achievement hunters, rejoice! We’ve added 35 new achievements, with 2 hidden ones for you to discover. Happy hunting!

Leveling has been rebalanced. It's now easier to level up in the early stages, but it gets progressively harder as you advance.
 
Lastly, we’ve balanced the existing passive skills to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

Sharpen your blades, embrace the challenge, and keep the feedback coming, Samurai! We're always listening and eager to improve based on your input.

Join us on our social channels and share your thoughts. Thanks for being part of our journey, and stay sharp!

notes.title: Rogue Samurai Content Update

After a long break, we’ve been cooking up some awesome new features for Rogue Samurai, and we’re super excited to share them with you!

Welcome to the Dojo! This is where you’ll face your first enemies. Just like Musashi’s legendary journey, your first checkpoint is this dojo. Battle rookies and bosses here to sharpen your skills.

-Keyboard buttons remapped for active skills.

Sharpen your blades and keep following us Samurais. We will add new contents and update the game regarding your feedback! Thanks for sharing this experience with us and stay healty 🙂

notes.title: Rogue Samurai - Devlog 0
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, I'm Alican. 3D artist of the team. And this is the story of how started making Rogue Samurai. This is devlog 0. So I will start from the beginning.

I had never read any manga before in my life. I hadn't watched much anime either. But a friend from work kept talking to me about this anime, Berserk. So, I decided to read the manga first and then watch the anime. I fell in love with this series and started searching for more content similar to it. That's when I stumbled upon Vagabond, and everything changed for me. The character, driven by a burning desire for power but maturing over time, deeply resonated with me. I read and finished Vagabond's manga with great pleasure. Then, I fell into a deep sense of longing. I wanted more. Despite the manga's popularity, there haven't been any anime adaptations or games made about it. The main character, Musashi, was not only significant for popular culture but also for Japanese history. I was surprised by the lack of works produced about Musashi. Because of this, my partners and I decided to create a game focused on Musashi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/64a4d469256e0118a919aca4b03d80167d6329e5.jpg[/img]

But before we start discussing the game, let me tell you a bit about ourselves. I've always wanted to make video games since I was a kid. When I finished high school, I started learning 3D modeling. Then, towards the end of the pandemic, I started working as a 3D artist at a mobile game company. I mostly worked on hyper casual games there. To be honest, it wasn't very satisfying for me because I wanted to make the kind of computer games I played in my childhood. Then, my current partner Enes offered me to start our game studio. By the way, he was the one who recommended me to read Berserk. Since our visions matched, I accepted his offer, and together we founded CO's Entertainment. After that, Berk joined us, and we started developing various projects.

Our first attempts weren't very successful. The scope of our projects was too large. So, we decided to dial things down and started working on a simpler game. We decided to make a rogue-lite action game. It's a game where you die, start over, and come back stronger each time, facing enemies and learning new things. Initially, we used a different theme, but it didn't satisfy us. Then, Musashi came to our minds again. His story was very fitting for this theme. To keep trying, getting stronger, and striving to be the best by battling the strongest samurais. That's why we decided to make Rogue Samurai based on Musashi's life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44611147/af64902da6b5dafc7f5ead9d045b7d7a6959e4f7.gif[/img]

Rogue Samurai is a samurai-themed game where you face waves of enemies. It's played from a top-down perspective. There are various passive and active abilities you can use in the game. Currently, you can only use the Katana, but we'll be adding new weapons in the future. Unlike other games in this genre, we've aimed to make Rogue Samurai's boss battles more engaging. During boss fights, the camera angle changes to a third-person perspective, providing a more immersive battle experience against the bosses. We've designed environment and character art to fit the feudal Japanese theme artistically. Currently, the game features our first map and the village where you respawn when you die. In this village, you can train, acquire different weapons, and upgrade your abilities. We've also added a small graveyard where a tombstone appears each time you die. Right now, the game doesn't have a story mode. We've all quit our jobs and invested all our money into this project. Due to budget constraints, we won't be adding a story mode initially, but it could be added post-release depending on your support. To support the game, you can add it to your wishlist. Your help would mean a lot to us.

While developing this game, we were influenced by works like Vagabond, the Samurai Trilogy, Kurosawa movies, and The Book of Five Rings. As we've discussed our plans, we'd love to hear your ideas about the game as well. If you're interested in the project, you can follow us on our other social media accounts as well. I will put all related links below. Until next time, see you...
